name: Bayesian reduced rank regression
model_likelihood: Low-rank multivariate regression with known covariates and latent-factor covariance.
prior: Progressively shrinking coefficient factors; infinite sparse factor prior for noise; informative PTVE shrinkage prior.
inference_algorithm: Mode estimate for Gamma combined with MCMC for other parameters.
estimand: Proportion of total phenotypic variation explained (PTVE).
data_input: Individual-level SNP, phenotype and known-covariate matrices.
tunable_settings: Regression-rank and noise-rank bounds; genome-wide regression rank 1; prior calibration probabilities and effect-size scale.
